end_to_end_flow: Design Studio emits Classical geometry/material parameters.
gui/app.py converts them to LHS parameters: shape, length, width, depth, top_thickness, hole_radius, top_wood, back_wood.
ROM/M4 readiness and STK parameter hash use ROM fingerprint plus LHS parameters.
After Save/ROM, gui/stk_app_audio_service.py schedules the Classical note-library job.
The note-library export builds one STK render entry per note with explicit note frequency, duration, physical factors, modal data, mix/coupling values, and output path.
STK/C++ renders WAV files into worker/staging/final cache; aliases are created for string/fret playback.
The website player loads the final cache through the guitar_player component.

direct_design_inputs_affecting_sound.woods: top/back wood IDs affect damping coefficients, material factors, identity vector, and physical factor exports.
direct_design_inputs_affecting_sound.length_width_depth: affect ROM fingerprint/hash, physical geometry proxies, mass/air/cavity/body identity features, and damping scale.
direct_design_inputs_affecting_sound.top_thickness: affects top stiffness/weight, damping scale, and identity features.
direct_design_inputs_affecting_sound.hole_radius: affects soundhole/air/cavity/radiation factors and identity features.

contrast_flattening_points: Physical factor clamps keep many derived values close to 1.0.
Final RMS/peak normalization reduces raw loudness differences.
Body gain calibration targets a stable body/string ratio.
Identity residual has audibility and RMS guards.
Fallback physical data may reduce differentiation if per-guitar audit data is missing.
safe_future_contrast_opportunities: Slightly increase spread of existing body_modal_gain and string_to_body_send_scale.
Band-limit stronger modal emphasis to physically relevant body bands, especially 120-450 Hz.
Slightly expand modal tau/Q spread through existing damping mappings.
Use existing radiation_brightness_factor and top/back/air weights for brightness/warmth contrast.
Use already available cavity, soundhole, bridge mobility, mass, and identity-vector features.
unsafe_ideas_to_avoid: Changing FEM/ROM solver behavior to force audio contrast.
Synthetic detuning unrelated to modal/geometry data.
Reintroducing BOX or ACOUSTIC website options.

local_cache_comparison.notes: VM should have runtime caches; inspect audio/app_stk_note_cache/classical/current_preview_* and saved_guitar_* there.

recommended_next_step.summary: Run a small VM cache audit over 2-3 existing Classical guitars comparing parameter hashes, cache specs, note metadata, factor spread, body/string ratios, decay slopes, and brightness/radiation metrics before changing synthesis.
recommended_next_step.possible_later_change: If the audit confirms weak differentiation, apply one bounded tuning pass to existing body modal/radiation/decay factors, around 10-15 percent, with no solver changes.

classic_risk: LOW: report only; no sound generation code changed.
